name: knowing
description: knowing, a learning and research skill set: make sense of a body of material such as notes, papers, or a wiki (understand), a sourced deep investigation (investigate), what's new on a topic from arXiv, Hacker News, GitHub, and OpenAlex (latest), interactive lessons with spaced practice for the user (learn), and teaching a learner, a child from their schoolwork or someone new to programming (tutor). Independent of flowstate. Ideas adapted from mvanhorn/last30days-skill and Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything (MIT).
